title: QA seat charter: runs on the maintainer's word after each development wave (no weekly cadence), and adds the scenario library beside the checklist owed list
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

## What the rule text says today

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md` 〈座位与唤醒〉: the QA seat is a Routine seat with a weekly fire the maintainer creates, plus one round after each release.
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §6: the standing regression is four weekly `qa-run` records (`owed:weekly`, `touched:`, `priority:P0`, `surface:api`) plus the post-release npm smoke.
- Neither text names the scenario library (`docs/qa/scenarios`, runner `packages/qa/scenarios`, `run-scenarios`). The QA seat's round today has no scenario half.

## What the maintainer ruled (in the QA seat's session `session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s`, 2026-11-08, verbatim)

1. 「也不需要每周跑，一波开发完了，我会和你说」: no weekly cadence. A QA round starts when the maintainer says a development wave is done.
2. 「纳入，本轮一起跑，立卡交 skills 车道」: the scenario library joins the QA seat's duties and runs in every round; the charter change is this card.

## The change this card asks for

- `lanes/qa.md` 〈座位与唤醒〉 and 〈每轮〉: replace the weekly Routine fire with "a round starts on the maintainer's word that a development wave is done"; keep the post-release npm smoke as it is unless the maintainer says otherwise.
- `lanes/qa.md` 〈每轮〉: add the scenario half: the `starter` cards of `docs/qa/scenarios`, `--modes scratch --packages workspace` (a wave is unreleased, so `published` would test the last release, not the wave), one card per command (the 2-hour background cap, `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` 〈Running the cards in a Claude Code cloud session〉), at most two in parallel per container. Where the scorecard goes (the round report, not a `qa-run` record, since it is not a checklist selector), and that a failing half judged a product defect is extracted as a defect card with a `QA-source:` line that points at the round, the same as a checklist `fail`.
- `lanes/qa.md` 〈每轮〉: the scenario runner's own constraints the seat must plan for: a subscription `oauth_token` login with neither `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` nor `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` set, and a permission mode other than Auto (Auto's classifier refuses the headless `claude -p` the runner spawns).
- checklist-test §6: the weekly wording becomes "per development wave, on the maintainer's word", or §6 points at `lanes/qa.md` for the cadence.
- `skills.md` line 25 (「checklist-test §6 两条例行按期由 `qa#1` 跑」) follows the same change.

## Governing text

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈优先级〉: a maintainer ruling outranks the rule text; until this card lands, the QA seat follows the rulings above and records them on its seat post.
- `lanes/qa.md` 〈边界〉: the QA seat does not edit skill text; the text belongs to `domain:skills`.

Route: `domain:skills` (`.claude/**` rule text). Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S).
